other_failure_modes.name: Target Leakage via In-Sample Target Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies target encoding to the training set using statistics computed from the exact same training set without a leave-one-out or out-of-fold strategy. This causes the target-encoded feature to contain the target variable of the current row, leading to severe model overfitting.
